jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(3)(C) inventory: the Champlain Valley Supervisory District's district is the Champlain Valley School District (member towns Charlotte, Hinesburg, Shelburne, St. George, Williston).
Champlain Valley School District (official district website).

sources.note: Champlain Valley School District board members page (official): the twelve current directors by town with term expirations -- Charlotte: Meghan Metzler (2027), Meghan Siket (2029); Hinesburg: Keith Roberts (2028), Cassandra Townshend (2029); Shelburne: Dave Connery (2029), Erika Lea (2028), Kate Webb (2027); St. George: Lindsay Colf (2028); Williston: Erin Henderson (2029), Brendan McMahon (2027), Jean Sanchez (2028), Sarah Showalter-Feuillette (2027).

The district's twelve seats are allocated by town and elected by each town's voters only (Charlotte 2, Hinesburg 2, Shelburne 3, St. George 1, Williston 4), per the CSSU study committee's own presentation ('12-Member Board. Board members elected by town based on 2010 census') and confirmed by the Town of Hinesburg's March 3, 2026 warning, whose ballot carries only Hinesburg's own 'Champlain Valley School District Director for a term of 3 years'. The verbatim 2016 articles of agreement were not retrieved; the composition sources agree.
